items.response: Sounds good. One thing is still open: Nate needs the kitchen wall choice by Monday. Action: Gather fresh options this afternoon and put them in a note you can send Nate before Monday.

You're welcome. Two holds are ready at Pape/Danforth until Sat 25 Apr, and the renewals are running. Tom's link request is still waiting for you after dinner. Action: Remind you about Tom's link after dinner.

Pulling your blocked Linear tickets so you can clear some before standup next week. I'll keep it to titles and status, plus what each is blocked on. Action: Query Linear for your tickets in a blocked state and list them with the blocker and who owns it, sorted by what you can unblock fastest.

From my notes, Leo's passport expired in January 2026 and yours in March 2026, with renewals planned, but I don't have confirmation that either was renewed, and I have nothing on Sam's. That matters because the Lisbon trip leaves 18 Dec and Portugal generally expects validity well beyond your return date. Action: Search your email, Drive and notes for passport renewal confirmations, then list the three expiry dates and flag anything that needs renewing now.

I'll pull every open payouts ticket and group them by workstream: reconciliation CSV export v2, payout status webhooks and the instant payout fee experiment. Going by my notes, the risks to watch for December are the bank partner API migration in November and a small team of about 2.5 engineers, but I'll judge from the actual tickets before calling anything at risk. Action: Query Linear for all open payouts tickets, group them by workstream, and rank the at-risk ones with reasons.

Not in Ontario: landlords can't ask for a damage deposit, only a rent deposit (for the last month's rent) and a refundable key deposit, so there is nothing to keep for scuffed walls. A landlord can apply to the Landlord and Tenant Board for damage beyond normal wear and tear, but ordinary scuffs are normal wear and tear. Diego should ask for any claim in writing and not agree to a deduction. Action: Save a short summary with these points and links for you to forward to Diego.

March really is a liar this year. Also, your note says your passport expires in March, so it's worth checking the renewal is moving. Action: Check whether 'renew passports' is done on your to-do list and tell you the status.

For jammy yolks, lower eggs straight from the fridge into boiling water for about 6.5 to 7 minutes, then straight into an ice bath for 5 minutes. For ramen eggs, peel them and marinate in soy sauce, mirin and water for a few hours or overnight, so start tonight for tomorrow. Action: Set a reminder tonight to boil and marinate the eggs, and add eggs, soy sauce and mirin to the grocery list if you're low.

I'm sorry, that's annoying. Your current car policy is Belairdirect, BD-AU-7731904, not Intact, and for a hit-and-run in the Loblaws lot I'd take photos of the dent and scratch this morning, note the time and location, and ask the store about lot cameras. Before filing, it's worth checking the deductible against the repair quote, since a claim can affect your premium. Action: Pull the policy documents from Drive, draft the claim details and photo checklist, and hold off filing until you decide.

The August long weekend is Fri 31 Jul to Mon 3 Aug, so I'll look at flights around that. I don't have fares in front of me yet, so I won't quote any. Action: Check Toronto to Vancouver return fares for one traveller and for you plus Leo around those dates, and send you a rough range with a note on when prices tend to rise.

I'll set up 30 minutes with Aisha and Diego on payout edge cases, since you asked for half an hour. The agenda goes in the invite: negative balances, reversed transfers, and sizing, with Aisha's edge-case list as pre-read since she prefers async. I'll avoid Wednesday afternoon, since you do school pickup for Leo and Jun at about 15:20. Action: Check all three calendars Monday to Wednesday, pick a slot that works, and send the 30 minute invite with the agenda.

For the team sync opener, try a one-word check-in ('describe your week in one word') or 'one thing that went better than expected'; it takes two minutes and stays light. For the open evening at home, something easy like cooking together, a board game or a movie night keeps it low-key. Action: Check your calendar for that day and the evening, then add the opener to the sync agenda and pencil in the evening plan once you pick.

Friday at last, and it sounds like you earned it. Nothing needs you tonight. Action: Bring up the Toronto Fintech Meetup items (talk title, headshot, bio) again on Monday, since the page needs them by 18 Sep.

My one recommendation is Brijwasi Sweets: assorted box Rs 1,450 plus Rs 120 delivery, Rs 1,570 in all, with the best freshness reviews (4.6) and same-day delivery if ordered before 14:00 IST. If you miss that cutoff, Tewari Bros delivers in 24 hours. Action: Order the Brijwasi box once I have your mom's delivery address and the message for the card.

I'll check Tom's calendar for the 24th. I can only see what's shared with you, which may be free/busy only. Action: Pull Tom's calendar for the 24th and list the free windows and what was blocking the rest, so you can write up why the pricing review slipped.

Ugh, a 40 minute bag wait plus a forgotten swim shirt and stuffie is a rough way to end a trip. I don't have your packing preferences saved, so I won't pretend to. I'll set up a simple checklist for the trip home with Leo's swim shirt and stuffie at the very top, and a reminder the night before to pack. Action: Create the trip-home packing checklist and the reminder; edit anything you want changed.

Sunday is blocked: 'Spy series night', 20:30-22:00 with Sam. For your mom, I'll find a well-reviewed Mumbai sweet shop that delivers and get quotes with delivery fees, then recommend one. Action: Add the Sunday block to the calendar after checking for conflicts, and ask for your mom's delivery address when I send the shop recommendation.

With 11 days to go, here's what's left to sort for Halloween night: the costume (a cardboard box can work with paint or tape and a theme), who walks with Leo and what time you head out, safety basics like reflective tape, a small flashlight and a bag or pillowcase, and treats for your own door. Action: Check your calendar for the evening of 31 Oct, and once you tell me his costume idea I'll make a parts list to pick up this weekend.

Here's the reply to your mom: 'Yes Mummy, but we've changed it. From this week our call is Saturdays at 8:30 am my time, 6:00 pm yours, because Sunday mornings are taken by Leo's soccer now. Hope that works for you.' I'll fix the recurring event with both Toronto and IST times in the invite. One flag: my notes show Leo's games on Saturday 9:00-10:00 with arrival at 8:45, which would clash with an 8:30 call, so tell me if that's still the case. Action: Send the reply to your mom, update the recurring event to Saturday 8:30 Toronto / 18:00 IST and end the old one, and text Kabir the new time.

Reminder is set for 17:15 for the Shoppers pickup. For the 1:1, Tom owns the series, so I can't edit his event, but I can accept his new Wednesday 11:30 series and remove your Thursday copy. Action: Check for Tom's new Wednesday invite starting in January and accept it, delete your Thursday copy, and if the invite isn't there yet, hold Wednesday 11:30 on your calendar and tell you.

Try this: 'If a payout fails because of a bank-side error, the system shall automatically retry the payout without merchant intervention.' It keeps the meaning and drops the stacked clauses. Action: Swap it into the PRD when you say so.

Checking your holds and due dates now, and I'll remind you about Tom's link after dinner. Action: Open your Toronto Public Library account, list what's ready for pickup and what's due this week, and renew anything eligible.

I'll make a note for Tanvi with the short version: the 2026 guideline is 2.1% for units first occupied before 15 Nov 2018, anything higher needs an LTB order, a 9% N1 without an LTB application can be answered by paying the guideline amount, and the landlord needs 90 days' notice once per 12 months. Links to the Ontario guideline page, the LTB above-guideline page and Form N1 will be included. Action: Create the note and a shareable link for Tanvi, and send you the link.

A chipped front tooth is an injury, so I'd phone Dr. Lin's office for the earliest slot rather than wait for online booking, ideally after school this week. I don't have the clinic address in front of me, so I can't give the travel time yet. Action: Find Dr. Lin's clinic details, call or book the earliest after-school slot this week, and tell you the time and how long it takes to get there from home.

From my notes, Leslieville yard waste is picked up every other Thursday since Thu 9 Apr, and the Victoria Day week moves pickup a day later, to Fri 22 May. That puts the next two at Fri 22 May and Thu 4 Jun, which I'd confirm against the City's collection calendar. Use paper yard waste bags or labelled rigid containers, no plastic, with branches under 7.5 cm, bundled, max 1.2 m long and 20 kg. Action: Check the City's calendar and add both pickups with a reminder the evening before.

Here's the note for #payouts-team: 'Heads down on focus time until 3 pm. I'll catch up on messages after, ping me if it's urgent.' Action: Set your Slack status to 'Heads down until 3:00 pm' and hold the note for your OK before posting.
Good night, Riya. Sleep well. Action: None.
I don't have this year's Leslieville farmers market opening date saved, so I won't guess. Action: Check the market's website and tell you the opening day and hours.

Done on the Sunday call with your mom Anjali: a recurring slot every Sunday at 9:00 am Toronto time (6:30 pm in Mumbai), kept clear with no other meetings booked over it. For Spanish between lessons with Carlos, a good start is a short daily practice of 10 to 15 minutes, mixing a quick vocab review, a role-play in real situations and a few quiz questions on what you got wrong. Action: Create the recurring Sunday 9:00 block with both time zones in the title, and tell me your level and the time of day you'd like to practise so I can set it up.
Added 'get passport photos for Leo' to your to-do list. Action: Add the to-do with no due date.

A heat warning is issued when hot weather is forecast to meet set limits for at least two days, usually daytime highs around 31 C with warm nights or a humidex near 40. An extended heat warning means those conditions are expected to last longer, typically three or more days. The exact thresholds vary by region. Action: Check the current alert and its end time for Toronto and send you what it says.

Enjoy the coffee on the porch, that sounds like a good morning. The career day talk is still Tue 31 Mar at 9:15, so there's time. Action: Snooze the prep block reminder for about an hour and bring it back later.

I'll message the kitchen crew about the electrician coming Monday and ask for the window that suits them. I don't know the electrician's arrival time or whether someone will be home Monday, so I'll check before proposing one. Action: Ask you for the electrician's arrival window and who will be home Monday, then message the crew with a couple of time options.

Two reminders: send Tom your comments on the strategy memo by Friday, and pick up Leo's library books from the Pape/Danforth branch on Saturday morning, bringing your library card ending 4417. Action: Set a reminder for Thursday evening and Friday morning for Tom's comments, and a Saturday morning reminder for the library pickup after checking the branch's opening hours.

I can rename them to the scan date, like 2025-06-14_Scan.pdf. I'll use each file's creation date as the scanned date unless the PDF has its own scan date in the metadata, and add a number if two share a day. I can check, but I need the old pricing page URL, and the new one if you have it. Action: Once I have the old URL, search your Notion and Google Drive docs for links to it, with extra attention to the beta materials, and list each doc with the link and the replacement.

For this week's class with Carlos on Thursday at 19:30, I'd focus on the subjunctive, noun-gender exceptions (el problema, el mapa, el tema, la mano), and Carlos's homework from your 'Spanish homework' notes, since you're prepping for the DELE B2. Welcome to Vancouver! I don't have the earlier flight search or the Lafourcade song piece in front of me, so I won't make up details. Action: Search my saved searches and our chat history for the flight I found before you booked and show the price in CAD (with the original currency in brackets if it was foreign), and find the Lafourcade piece for Mei.

I don't have yesterday's route time in front of me, so I don't want to guess. Action: Look for the saved route or plan from yesterday and tell you how long it was supposed to take, including the Big Apple stop.

I also checked the beta retro: 9 yes, Olivia tentative, Jonah hasn't replied, and 14 stickies with webhook retries the top theme. I haven't finished checking your calendar for the 22nd. I don't have the rink status or the weather for Saturday in front of me, so I'd rather check than guess. Action: Check the City's rink status for Withrow Park and Saturday afternoon's forecast, look at when Leo's swim ends, and tell you whether skating after swim looks workable.

I'll set up a 25 minute call with Olivia and Aisha on the 9th at 3:30pm, 15:30-15:55, with the agenda in the invite: 1) where certification stands 2) what sales can and can't say 3) next checkpoint. I'll use the next upcoming 9th; tell me if you meant another month. Action: Check all three calendars for conflicts, then send the invite titled 'GA target wording for sales' with the agenda.

Regular mail from Toronto to Mumbai usually takes somewhere around one to three weeks, and it can take longer if the post is busy. I don't have Canada Post's current estimate in front of me. Action: Check Canada Post's current international letter timing and price, including tracked options, and send you the best option.

Okay, holding the charcoal bag order until you've checked with Sam. Tell me what's set up in the basement kitchen when you're ready. East End Plumbing is still confirmed for Mon 29 Jun, 09:00-12:00, with technician Raj, and they need the inside shut-off valve accessible. Action: Hold the order and add the shut-off valve note to your Monday reminder.

I hear you, a month and more of dust and takeout without a working kitchen is a lot, and wanting toast in your own kitchen is completely fair. For the floors, stop sweeping dry. Vacuum first with a soft brush attachment and no beater bar, then go over it with a dry microfiber mop along the grain, and finish with a barely damp cloth, changing it often so the grit doesn't get dragged around. Action: Save these steps as a short dust-cleanup checklist in your notes.
